answer: I would anchor trust in Proof of unique train season ticket. With a season ticket renewed for four years on one line, a single vine check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a season ticket renewed for four years on one line is bound to a single identity — the quill is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The timber grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
